title: Effigy of Malice

infobox.Usage: Charred Warrior (43.2% chance), Charred Marksman (43.2% chance), Charred Warlock (8.6% chance)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Effigy of Malice is a creature spawner found in Charred Fortresses within the Ashlands. The Effigy can spawn any Charred:
• Charred Warrior (43.2% chance)
• Charred Marksman (43.2% chance)
• Charred Warlock (8.6% chance)
Spawned enemies have a 4.75% chance to be 1-star and a 0.25% chance to be 2-star.
The Effigy activates when there is a player within 60 meters. The effigy attempts to spawn within four meters every 12 seconds.
